text:
ellie.pm: uploaded new mocks (figma). main asks: preview role on invite, pick SSO toggle wording, and make audit filters discoverable + keyboard friendly
mika.design: i like the role-preview idea. UI: show role pill left of email input so it's always visible before sending
zoe-ux: accessibility wins if role is first. make pill focusable and use aria-expanded when it opens into a picker
parth (eng): agreed. note: inline picker must support keyboard: Enter to open, Arrow keys to move, Enter to select, Esc to cancel
ellie.pm: SSO toggle label options: "Require SSO" vs "SSO required" vs "Enforce SSO". which reads best to admins?
mika.design: "Require SSO" reads like an action but is concise. pair it with helper text: "All new members must use your SSO provider."
zoe-ux: helper text should be linked via aria-describedby. announce state changes in a polite live region: "SSO requirement enabled"
parth (eng): backend needs to emit an audit event when toggle changes. propose event type `sso_toggle_v1` with fields tenant_id, actor_id, before, after, request_id
infra-bot: automation note: audit events must include tenant_id and request_id per retention policy
ellie.pm: audit nav feedback: users can't find invite-related events. idea: add a persistent saved filter area with chips and counts (e.g., Invites (14), SSO (3), Role changes (22))
mika.design: chips look good; ensure visible focus ring and that Left/Right arrow moves between chips (roving tabindex pattern)
zoe-ux: when a filter is applied announce via live region: "Invites filter applied, 14 results". also provide keyboard shortcut: / then type filter name
parth (eng): to avoid heavy client work we'll add GET /audit/summary?org_id=... to return counts per event_type. example response: ```[{"type":"invite_sent","count":14},{"type":"sso_toggle","count":3}]```
ellie.pm: invite copy: current text "Invite members by email" -> propose "Invite by email — select role before sending" and show expiry in modal: "Invitation expires in 7 days"
mika.design: small tweak: replace "Members" with "Organization members" in modal copy to reduce ambiguity across nested orgs
zoe-ux: modal accessibility: trap focus, restore focus on close, provide aria-live for confirmation: "Invitation sent to alice@example.com; expires in 7 days"
parth (eng): inline role edits should emit `role_update_inline` events with before/after and actor. mobile fallback opens a sheet. will implement audit schema update
infra-bot: deploy checklist: include route shim for audit nav param `view=auditable` so scrapers can hit stable endpoints
ellie.pm: acceptance criteria I'll add to PRJ-6210: figma link, keyboard spec, audit schema examples, and copy approvals. please add comments if anything blocks
mika.design: i'll post updated color tokens for contrast check on compact row pills
zoe-ux: i'll add the roving tabindex keyboard spec and ARIA mapping in the ticket
parth (eng): i'll add API contract and event payload examples to the PR
infra-bot: staging deploy queued after code review
